fact: An AI-supported narrative-synthesis module (RAID) and error-detection modules in the OMDIP platform, integrated with DHIS2 across 335 public health facilities in 15 districts, raised timely report submission from 27% to 100% and cut data-cleaning time from 10.2 to 2.9 days between January 2023 and June 2024.
title: Transforming routine health data use in LMICs through modular, AI-supported automation: insights from Zimbabwe
